mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% for two consecutive months signals central bank over-tightening, which raises real discount rates and dampens equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 and remains above 3.0 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: accelerating inflation in a restrictive policy environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified inflation spike, or CPIAUCSL reverts below 3% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 monthly increases, indicating strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the identified employment surge, or PAYEMS does not sustain the threshold for 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified demand weakness, or INDPRO recovers within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the RSAFS supply gauge accompanied by a simultaneous rise in GDPC1 demand index (both within the same month) suggests conflicting economic signals that create uncertainty, depressing S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < previous month AND GDPC1 > previous month in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during such conflicting events, or the effect is negligible across multiple occurrences.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for four consecutive months in a post-crisis environment, it signals accommodative policy sustaining risk asset valuations, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the low-rate period, or FEDFUNDS reverts before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 4% in a single month suggests rising wage pressures and potential inflation, which can erode real equity returns and drive negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0 in a single month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the wage-price spike, or UNRATE reverts before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of HOUST below 1500 units indicate weakening consumer demand, which reduces future earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the demand weakness, or HOUST recovers within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and RSAFS both fall sequentially by at least 5% in the same month, it reflects simultaneous supply-side shocks that depress corporate outlooks and drive negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < prev_month * 0.95 AND RSAFS < prev_month * 0.95 in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such events, or the effect is not reproducible in multiple shock episodes.
